heading: On the snow. Off the clock.
intro: Ski days are at the heart of the weekend, with room to find your own pace. Participation and booking details are still being worked out.

items.title: Skiing at Yellowstone Club & Big Sky
items.description: We plan to ski a mix of Yellowstone Club and Big Sky Friday through Sunday. We may need to purchase passes for Big Sky; details will follow. Have an Ikon pass? Text Carter so we can plan accordingly.

items.title: Ski rentals
items.description: Compare four Big Sky shops and three Bozeman options in our rental guide, featuring Gallatin Alpine Sports. Plan for skiing February 19?21, and confirm pickup and return arrangements for your travel schedule. Rates in the guide are reference prices; confirm current pricing and availability with the shop.

items.title: Optional lessons
items.description: Interested in a ski lesson? Text Carter so we can gauge interest and plan lessons. Provider, availability, and booking details will follow.

items.title: Backcountry excursion
items.description: A possible Saturday outing. Guide, conditions, ability requirements, equipment, cost, and booking arrangements are to be confirmed.

items.title: Curling
items.description: A Saturday activity in the working itinerary. Venue, time, equipment, and participation details are to be confirmed.

items.title: A slower kind of mountain day
items.description: You don’t need skis to join the weekend. Non-skier options and group meeting plans will be added as arrangements are confirmed.
